integrity: The all-order proof uses explicit vertex-degree constructions. Finite replay is used as corroboration, never as a substitute for the proof. No independent historical-priority or mathematical certification claimed.
scientific_limitations: Two-token graphs only; exactly one missing base edge; the all-order count of optimal cuts is not evaluated, except at n=5. An older equivalent formulation could have escaped indexed search.
title: Single-edge deletion stability of maximum cuts in two-token complete graphs
